title: gymnanthemum silhetense
intro: Gymnanthemum silhetense, commonly known as Silhetan lemongrass, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of Gymnanthemum silhetense are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including citral, geraniol, and limonene, which exhibit antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. Additionally, the plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and skin infections.
